# Test partition with fresh import
import sys
for mod_name in list(sys.modules.keys()):
    if 'boltons' in mod_name:
        del sys.modules[mod_name]

from boltons.iterutils import partition

print("Testing partition:")

# Single predicate (original behavior)
result = partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1)
print(f"  partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1) = {result}")
print(f"  Expected: ([2, 3], [1])")
print(f"  Match: {result == ([2, 3], [1])}")

# Multiple predicates
result = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
print(f"\n  partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3]) = {result}")
print(f"  Expected: ([2], [1], [3])")
print(f"  Match: {result == ([2], [1], [3])}")

# Overlapping predicates
result = partition([1, 2, 3, 4], [lambda x: x > 2, lambda x: x < 3])
print(f"\n  partition([1, 2, 3, 4], [lambda x: x > 2, lambda x: x < 3]) = {result}")
print(f"  Expected: ([3, 4], [], [1, 2])")
print(f"  Match: {result == ([3, 4], [], [1, 2])}")

# Empty input
result = partition([], lambda x: x > 0)
print(f"\n  partition([], lambda x: x > 0) = {result}")
print(f"  Expected: ([], [])")
print(f"  Match: {result == ([], [])}")
